mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates and stimulates risk appetite, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the Federal Reserve maintains accommodative policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that prompts delayed rate hikes, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through reduced bond yield pressure.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand, triggering equity outflows to safe assets and positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 60-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is statistically insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Three consecutive months of manufacturing output growth below 0.5% (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruption, increasing inflation risk and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO growth remains below 0.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Residential construction permits above 750 thousand units (HOUST) indicate housing market strength, boosting consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 750 thousand units.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% triggers aggressive Federal Reserve rate hikes, increasing bond yields and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL year-over-year growth exceeds 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous unemployment rate above 7.5% and non-farm payrolls below 130,000 thousand persons signals severe labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint condition of UNRATE>7.5 and PAYEMS<130000 fails to produce negative 20-day returns in more than 55% of cases, or the interaction effect is insignificant (p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Housing market boom (HOUST > 750 thousand units) combined with rising consumer spending (RSAFS > 400,000 million dollars) indicates strong economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when HOUST exceeds 750 and RSAFS exceeds 400000.
